extracted.intended_audience: department and agency heads, advisory committee administrators, General Services Administration, White House and agency legal counsel
extracted.subtask_description: An Executive Order continuing specified Federal advisory committees (and reestablishing one), delegating most Presidential functions under the Federal Advisory Committee Act (FACA) to department/agency heads, revoking certain prior Executive Orders, and specifying effectiveness. Applies to named committees and implementing authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuation of specified advisory committees until September 30, 1995
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 1: Each advisory committee listed below is continued until September 30, 1995.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The listed committees (with their originating Executive Orders and agency sponsors) are: (a) Committee for the Preservation of the White House; Executive Order No. 11145, as amended (Department of the Interior); (b) Federal Advisory Council on Occupational Safety and Health; Executive Order No. 12196, as amended (Department of Labor); (c) President’s Commission on White House Fellowships; Executive Order No. 11183, as amended (Office of Personnel Management); (d) President’s Committee on the Arts and Humanities; Executive Order No. 12367, as amended (National Endowment for the Arts); (e) President’s Committee on the International Labor Organization; Executive Order No. 12216 (Department of Labor); (f) President’s Committee on Mental Retardation; Executive Order No. 11776, as amended (Department of Health and Human Services); (g) President’s Committee on the National Medal of Science; Executive Order No. 11287, as amended (National Science Foundation); (h) President’s Council on Physical Fitness and Sports; Executive Order No. 12345, as amended (Department of Health and Human Services); (i) President’s Export Council; Executive Order No. 12131, as amended (Department of Commerce); and (j) President’s National Security Telecommunications Advisory Committee; Executive Order No. 12382, as amended (Department of Defense).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reestablishment and continuance of the President’s Council of Advisors on Science and Technology (PCAST)
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 2: The President’s Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, Executive Order No. 12700, as amended (Office of Science and Technology Policy), the authority for which expired on June 30, 1993, is hereby reestablished in accordance with Executive Order No. 12700, as amended, and shall continue until September 30, 1995.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies reestablishment under its prior Executive Order authority and the same continuance date as the other committees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation of Presidential functions under FACA to agency heads (except annual Congressional reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 3: Notwithstanding other Executive Orders, the functions of the President under the Federal Advisory Committee Act that are applicable to the committees listed in sections 1 and 2 of this order, except that of reporting annually to the Congress, shall be performed by the head of the department or agency designated after each committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agency/department heads designated after each committee are responsible for performing Presidential functions under FACA for those committees; the one exception retained for the President is the annual reporting to Congress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines and procedures to be established by the Administrator of General Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 3 (continued): The performance of those delegated functions by department or agency heads shall be in accordance with the guidelines and procedures established by the Administrator of General Services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assigns the Administrator of General Services authority to establish the guidelines and procedures that govern how agency heads carry out the delegated Presidential FACA functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revocation of Executive Orders establishing terminated or completed committees
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 4: The following Executive Orders or sections thereof, which established committees that have terminated or whose work is completed, are revoked.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revoked orders/sections listed: (a) Executive Order No. 12792 (National Commission on America’s Urban Families); (b) Executive Order No. 12813, as amended by EO No. 12815 (President’s Commission on the Management of the Agency for International Development Programs); (c) Executive Order No. 12720, as amended by EO No. 12783 (President’s Council on Rural America); (d) Executive Order No. 12696, as amended by EO No. 12756 (President’s Drug Advisory Council); (e) Executive Order No. 12687, as amended by EOs Nos. 12741 and 12785 (President’s Education Policy Advisory Committee); and (f) Section 5 of Executive Order No. 12675 (Vice President’s Space Policy Advisory Board).

rubrics_metrics.name: Supersession of Executive Order No. 12774
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 5: Executive Order No. 12774 is superseded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declares that EO 12774 is superseded by this order (no further detail provided in text).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective date of the order
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 6: This order shall be effective September 30, 1993.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the date on which the continuances, revocations, reestablishment, delegations, and supersession become effective.
